name: tapo-ses
description: Tapo C210 hoparlöründen özel MP3 çalan Windows ve macOS uygulaması.
author: Tapo Ses

scripts.dev: npm run build:electron && concurrently -k -n vite,app "vite" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.build: node scripts/icon.mjs && npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron
scripts.dist: npm run fetch:ffmpeg && npm run build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win zip --x64 && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac zip --x64 --arm64
scripts.dist:win: npm run fetch:ffmpeg && npm run build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win nsis zip --x64
scripts.dist:mac: npm run fetch:ffmpeg && npm run build && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac zip dmg --x64 --arm64
